hooks: Your media business idea could receive $10,000. Here’s who 100 Dreams is for.
100 Dreams is backing 100 media business ideas. Read this before you register.
Thinking about a creator business? Save the 100 Dreams dates and requirements.

instagram.caption:
Your media business idea could receive USD 10,000 through 100 Dreams. Here’s what the official page actually says.

100 people will be selected worldwide. Support includes funding towards their business, a UAE company licence, a Dubai Summit trip, and a six-week kickstart programme with Simon Squibb and the Dream team. Golden Visa support is subject to government approval.

It is for media business ideas: creator brands, entertainment, film and video production, media technology, and new media business models. Applicants must be 18 or older and able to establish a UAE company, travel to Dubai, and participate in all six weeks. Relocation is not required.

Applications open 20 November 2026. You can register interest now, but that does not guarantee selection. The official landing page currently lists no minimum follower count; check the full application rules when released.

My preparation advice: explain who your idea serves, what you would build with the funding, and what you have already made or tested. This is my checklist, not official selection criteria.

Comment DREAM for the official link and my pitch checklist.

Independent guide; not affiliated with 100 Dreams or its organisers. Information checked 20 October 2026.
